recentEvents.text: DECISION REQUIRED Herzeg-Bosna · 13 Sep 1993 Owen-Stoltenberg: Mostar Records Its Posture PRESIDENTIAL RESPONSE Accept the Union of Three Republics framework HISTORICAL DEFAULT This is the historically attested choice. You are free to choose any option. Acknowledge the Owen-Stoltenberg map: HZ HB is one of three constitutive ethnic republics with a favorable central-Bosnia and western Herzegovina territorial allocation. Mate Boban signs for the HZ HB Presidency; Zagreb's directive is honored. Herzeg-Bosna morale +4 Herzeg-Bosna Patron Confidence +10 Herzeg-Bosna Int'l Standing +8 Herzeg-Bosna Negotiating Leverage +5 Herzeg-Bosna Internal Cohesion +5 Condition acceptance on central Bosnia amendments Acknowledge the Union of Three Republics framework but condition the signature on central Bosnia territorial amendments — Vitez, Kiseljak, Busovaca, Prozor. Zagreb tolerates the conditional posture without full alignment; the central Bosnia frictions remain unresolved. Herzeg-Bosna morale +2 Herzeg-Bosna Patron Confidence -5 Herzeg-Bosna Negotiating Leverage -5 Herzeg-Bosna Internal Cohesion +3 Reject the Union of Three Republics Refuse the Owen-Stoltenberg map. The HZ HB Presidency defies Zagreb's directive — Tudjman's patron-confidence collapses, but a paradoxical opening to RBiH joint-front diplomacy materializes as the Zagreb-backed plan is rejected from the HVO side. International standing falls; the central-Bosnia war continues without a settlement frame. Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina / Herzeg-Bosna alliance +0.05 Herzeg-Bosna morale -3 Herzeg-Bosna Patron Confidence -25 Herzeg-Bosna Int'l Standing -10 Herzeg-Bosna Internal Cohesion -5 SITUATION Owen and Stoltenberg's Union of Three Republics plan was tabled aboard HMS Invincible on 20 September 1993. The map ratifies Herceg-Bosna as one of three constitutive ethnic republics, with the central-Bosnia and western Herzegovina territorial allocation drawn favorably to Croat claims. Zagreb's directive is unambiguous: Tudjman has signaled to Boban that the HZ HB Presidency is to sign. The Mostar Presidency must record its posture toward the Invincible package — accept the Union of Three Republics framework, reje
